key_facts.fact: Anupama Pathirage, Director and Head of Product Management for Integration at WSO2, published the release details for WSO2 Integrator 5.1 on October 19, 2026.
WSO2 Integrator 5.1 builds on the AI-native foundation introduced in version 5.0 to expand support for building enterprise-grade AI agents.
LinkedIn user Viththagan Roy Nesarajah shared a look at the new AI-first development experience coming in WSO2 Integrator 5.1.0 on October 1, 2026.
